title: Apply warm beige marble global background with dark overlay across all pages

requirements.summary: Set the global body background color to a warm beige marble tone (#DCCBB5) across the entire application
acceptanceCriteria: The body element has a background-color of #DCCBB5 or equivalent warm beige marble tone applied globally.
All pages (Home, Technical, Non-Technical, Register, Payment, Success, Contact, Admin, Dashboard) show the beige marble background.
No page retains the previous dark/black background at the body level.

file_operations.description: Add a body rule setting background-color to #DCCBB5 in the global stylesheet to apply the warm beige marble tone across all pages and routes.

requirements.summary: Add a full-viewport fixed dark overlay element with background rgba(0,0,0,0.75) below all page content to maintain readability and premium look of neon elements
acceptanceCriteria: A fixed full-viewport pseudo-element or overlay div with background rgba(0,0,0,0.75) is rendered above the body background but below all page content.
Orange neon glow effects and text remain fully visible and unobstructed.
No buttons, inputs, links, or interactive elements are blocked by the overlay.
The overlay covers 100vw × 100vh on all pages.

file_operations.description: Add a body::before pseudo-element with position:fixed, top:0, left:0, width:100vw, height:100vh, background:rgba(0,0,0,0.75), z-index:0, and pointer-events:none to create a dark overlay above the beige background but below all page content without blocking any interactions.

requirements.summary: Ensure that all existing layout, spacing, font sizes, animations, neon highlights, circuit patterns, and functional components remain completely unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: No changes are made to any page component files beyond global CSS.
All animations (PhoenixIntro, LoadingScreen, CountdownTimer, CircuitPattern) continue to function as before.
Section spacing, font sizes, button styles, and layout are identical to the previous version.
Neon orange glow effects remain visually intact.

file_operations.description: Verify that all existing CSS rules, Tailwind utilities, custom properties, neon effects, and keyframe animations remain unchanged and intact after adding the body background and overlay styles.
